Aurobindo Pharma Ltd has informed the Exchange that the auditor's have conducted the limited review of the unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2006 and found the same to be in order subject to certain observations. The auditor's observations are: "No provision has been made for diminution aggregating to Rs. 610,341,873 in the carrying value of investments in certain wholly owned subsidiaries. Further an aggregate amount of Rs. 1,810,684,056 is due from the said subsidiaries being loans granted by the Company. Management considers these investments to be strategic in nature and considering the nature of industry and gestation period involved. Management is of the opinion that the diminution in the value is temporary. Hence Management believes that no provision is necessary for such diminution in the values of investments. We are unable to express an opinion on the uncertainties related to the recoverability of the carrying value of the investments.

Aurobindo Pharma Ltd has informed the Exchange that The "Forbes Magazine" has listed Aurobindo among the "Best under a Billion - Asia's Rising Companies" in its latest issue dated November 01, 2004. The list covers the 100 best Smaller-Size enterprises in both Asia-Pacific and Europe. The magazine informs that a database of 2600 publicly traded companies, which had under US$ 1 Billion year revenue and five-year returns on capital of at least 5 percent, was screened to prepare the list. Sustained gains in sales and returns were considered for ranking. It also looked for companies with a track record of rewarding their shareholders.  The Company has further added that they are happy to be listed by the magazine and are confident that this recognition shall further fuel the company to excel.
